runsheet.short_description: Disconnect webinar audio+video from the auditorium.
[[Webinar Sentinel]] confirm where [[Zoom Master]] will sit.
Make sure the Speaker has arrived. Greet the Speaker, mention time cue signals, and direct them to the [[Zoom Master]] for setup.

runsheet.more_info: Chat > menu > attendees can chat with: nobody.

runsheet.short_description: Promote [[Webinar Sentinel]], [[Q&A Producer]], and maybe backstage to cohost in the Zoom webinar.

Help the Speaker install Zoom Client (if on their own laptop), join the Zoom Webinar and disconnect audio+video (if on-site), test aduio+video input+output (if online), and test screenshare and sound share (always). Direct the Speaker to the [[Q&A Producer]] for coordination.
Agree on the Q&A signal with the Speaker.
Grab a mic and keep it for the whole session.
Connect webinar audio+video to the auditorium.

Sit in the corner of the stage. Join Zoom on laptop and disconnect audio+video. Keep both the Q&A panel and the participants view (for raised hands) open at all times. Balance online VS on-site questions.
Start the session. Introduce the Speaker. Speaker starts. Sit in the corner of the stage with the [[Q&A Producer]].

Sit on-site in the backstage but view only the Zoom Webinar. Not only listen, but try to understand and enjoy the talk --- you catch more issues this way. Keep the on-site screen visible so any mismatch is catched, but pay main attention to the webinar. Use headphones. Upon issues, use judgement: Either unmute to raise the issue, or contact the [[Zoom Master]] immediately by walking to them.
If a panelist account is making noises, mute it.
Remind the Speaker of time elapsed; during Q&A, keep track of time.
Sit in the corner of the audience to enjoy the talk.
Whenever a question from the on-site audience is taken, give your mic to them.
